'''Wynn Barezz''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] stationed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Working out of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Barezz reported to<ref name="Alien Species" /> his<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> superiors that an armed cargo ship had been infected with the [[Death Seed]] plague.<ref name="Alien Species" />
